content.title: ALKS to Enter Sleep Disorder Market With $2.1B Avadel Acquisition
content.summary: Alkermes inks $2.1B deal to acquire Avadel, adding the latter's Lumryz and new growth potential to its portfolio.

content.title: SNY's Efdoralprin Alfa Meets Key Endpoints in Rare Disease Study
content.summary: Sanofi's efdoralprin alfa meets all key endpoints in a global phase II study, showing potential as a first restorative recombinant therapy for AATD.

content.title: ESPR Aims to Diversify With Rare Liver Disease Candidate, Stock Up
content.summary: Esperion selects ESP-2001 as a preclinical candidate for primary sclerosing cholangitis, a rare liver disease, aiming to begin clinical studies in 2026.

content.title: Viatris Acquires Aculys Pharma to Expand Neurology Portfolio in Japan
content.summary: VTRS acquires Aculys Pharma to boost its CNS portfolio in Japan, gaining rights to pitolisant and Spydia for narcolepsy and seizure management, respectively.

content.title: RCKT Stock Up as FDA Accepts Resubmitted BLA for Gene Therapy
content.summary: Rocket Pharmaceuticals surges as the FDA accepts its resubmitted BLA for Kresladi, a gene therapy targeting the rare LAD-I disorder.

content.title: TVRD Stock Plunges 84% After Phase II Fibrosis Study Misses Key Goals
content.summary: Tvardi Therapeutics' shares crater after its phase II idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis study shows no meaningful benefit from TTI-101 therapy compared to placebo.

content.title: CDTX Stock Up on FDA's Breakthrough Therapy Tag for CD388 in Influenza
content.summary: Cidara Therapeutics wins FDA Breakthrough Therapy tag for CD388 for the prevention of seasonal influenza. Stock rises.

content.title: OVID Stock Soars 39% in a Month Following Upbeat Epilepsy Study Data
content.summary: Ovid Therapeutics jumps 39% in a month after phase I epilepsy study data show superior efficacy of its lead candidate, OV329, hinting at best-in-class potential.

content.title: KALA Stock Crashes 88% in a Month Following Eye Disorder Study Failure
content.summary: KALA BIO stock plunges 88% after its KPI-012 eye disorder study fails to meet goals, forcing the company to scrap its pipeline and explore strategic options.

content.title: AstraZeneca's Baxdrostat Meets Goal in Resistant Hypertension Study
content.summary: AZN's baxdrostat hit the main goal in the phase III Bax24 study, showing significant blood pressure reductions in patients with resistant hypertension.
